item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting a UN warning of ethnic cleansing, while Israeli raids across the West Bank injured Palestinians and led to arrests. Israeli drones struck the southern Gaza Strip, wounding 14 people, and IDF operations killed a Hamas commander who had held hostages and four Hamas operatives in separate Gaza strikes. Shin Bet is allowing Hamas operatives to choose whether they are killed alone or with their families, and Israel razed the homes of gunmen responsible for a deadly Hebron shooting. Israel's top court ordered repairs to West Bank homes torched by settlers. The United Nations Commission reported war crimes and genocide even after a Gaza ceasefire, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
